raw:
The task is to write UI strings for an app in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage). The screen: computer peripheral settings page: adjust pointer device movement speed, and display device brightness.

Need:
- s1: label for pointer device speed
- s2: label for display device brightness
- s3: title of this settings page

Taiwan UI conventions:
- Mouse = 滑鼠, but "指標裝置" (pointing device) is a generic term. In Windows Taiwan settings, it's "滑鼠" or "指標裝置". The prompt says "指標裝置" (pointer device), so keeping 指標裝置 is fine.
- Speed of pointer: In Windows settings, "指標速度" (pointer speed). So s1: "指標速度" or "指標裝置速度". Label for pointer device speed — "指標速度" is common (Windows uses 「指標速度」in 滑鼠 settings). Given the screen says 指標裝置的移動速度, label could be 「指標速度」or 「移動速度」. I'll use 「指標速度」 as it's the standard Windows Taiwan term.

- Brightness: 「亮度」. Display device brightness label: 「亮度」or 「螢幕亮度」. The prompt says 顯示裝置的亮度 — screen brightness is commonly 「螢幕亮度」but here "顯示裝置" is generic (could be external monitor). Label could be 「顯示器亮度」. In Taiwan, 顯示器 = display/monitor (not 屏幕). So s2: 「顯示器亮度」.

- s3: page title: 「周邊設定」? The screen is 電腦周邊設定頁 (computer peripheral settings page). Note: 周邊 vs 週邊 — Taiwan commonly uses 週邊 for peripheral (週邊設備), but 周邊 is also used. Microsoft style guide uses 「週邊」for peripheral devices (e.g., 周邊設備 vs 週邊設備). Actually Taiwan Microsoft docs often use 「周邊設備」. Hmm. Common usage: 電腦週邊設備. Both appear. The prompt itself wrote 周邊. Title could be 「裝置設定」 or 「周邊裝置設定」 or 「週邊設定」.

Let me pick: s3: 「周邊裝置設定」 or 「裝置與顯示設定」? The page adjusts pointer speed and display brightness. Title: 「週邊設定」or 「裝置設定」. Given prompt: 電腦周邊設定頁, title 「周邊設定」 seems direct. But Taiwan preferred: 「週邊」. Many Taiwan glossaries: peripheral = 週邊設備／周邊設備 both seen; Microsoft Taiwan language portal uses 「周邊」? Let me recall: Microsoft terminology: "peripheral" → 「週邊」 I believe. Actually Microsoft Language Portal: peripheral device = 周邊裝置? Hmm. I recall "周邊設備" is common in Taiwan textbooks. Also 「週邊」. Both acceptable; 台灣教育部: 周邊 vs 週邊 — 「周」 is the standard form per 台灣教育部 for 環繞 (四周/周圍/周邊), 週 is for week/cycle (週次、週期). So per MOE, 周邊 is correct (周圍、周邊 use 周). So 「周邊設定」 is fine.

Title could be 「周邊裝置設定」since it's about 裝置. Or simply 「裝置設定」. I'll go with 「周邊裝置設定」 maybe. But keep simple: the page is "電腦周邊設定頁" so title 「周邊裝置設定」 works well in Taiwan style (device = 裝置).

s1: 「指標速度」 — Windows label: 「指標速度」 (Select pointer speed). Good.

s2: 「顯示器亮度」 — Taiwan term for display device = 顯示器. Good. Alternatively 「螢幕亮度」 but 顯示器 more generic matching prompt "顯示裝置".

Output JSON only: {"s1": "指標速度", "s2": "顯示器亮度", "s3": "周邊裝置設定"}

Ensure no mainland terms: none used. Good.</think>{"s1": "指標速度", "s2": "顯示器亮度", "s3": "周邊裝置設定"}
